verses.textZhCnvs: 提哥亚的牧人阿摩司，在犹大王乌西雅和以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安作王的日子，大地震前二年所见的异象，就是有关以色列的话，记在下面。
verses.textZhCuv: 当犹大王乌西雅，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在位的时候，大地震前二年，提哥亚牧人中的阿摩司得默示论以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa—the vision he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of Amos, who was among the shepherds of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of Amos, who was among the sheepbreeders of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given to Amos, a shepherd from the town of Tekoa in Judah. He received this message in visions two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam II, the son of Jehoash, was king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders from Tekoa, which he saw in visions concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.textEn: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa—the vision he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他说： "耶和华从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声； 牧人的草场因此悲哀， 迦密的山顶枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说： "耶和华从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声； 牧人的草场因此悲哀， 迦密的山顶枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：耶和华必从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声； 牧人的草场要悲哀； 迦密的山顶要枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "The Lord roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said: "The Lord roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withers."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "The Lord roars from Zion, And utters His voice from Jerusalem; The pastures of the shepherds mourn, And the top of Carmel withers."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what he saw and heard: "The Lord ’s voice will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem! The lush pastures of the shepherds will dry up; the grass on Mount Carmel will wither and die."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "The Lord roars from Zion, And from Jerusalem He utters His voice; And the shepherds’ pasture grounds mourn, And the summit of Carmel dries up."
verses.textEn: He said: "The Lord roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers."

verses.textEnNiv: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will break the gate-bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitants from the Valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from Beth-eden; and the people of Syria shall go into exile to Kir," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also break the gate bar of Damascus, And cut off the inhabitant from the Valley of Aven, And the one who holds the scepter from Beth Eden. The people of Syria shall go captive to Kir," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will break down the gates of Damascus and slaughter the people in the valley of Aven. I will destroy the ruler in Beth-eden, and the people of Aram will go as captives to Kir," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also break the gate bar of Damascus, And eliminate every inhabitant from the Valley of Aven, As well as him who holds the scepter, from Beth-eden; So the people of Aram will be exiled to Kir," Says the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必剪除亚实突的居民， 以及亚实基伦掌权的领袖； 我必伸手攻击以革伦， 把余剩的非利士人都灭绝。’ 这是主耶和华说的。

verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines are dead," says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will cut off the inhabitants from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; I will turn my hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish," says the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, And the one who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; I will turn My hand against Ekron, And the remnant of the Philistines shall perish," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will slaughter the people of Ashdod and destroy the king of Ashkelon. Then I will turn to attack Ekron, and the few Philistines still left will be killed," says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also eliminate every inhabitant from Ashdod, As well as him who holds the scepter, from Ashkelon; And I will direct My power against Ekron, And the remnant of the Philistines will perish," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines are dead," says the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘以东三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他拿刀追杀他的兄弟， 没有丝毫怜悯； 他的怒气不断爆发， 他的忿怒永不止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘以东三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他拿刀追杀他的兄弟， 没有丝毫怜悯； 他的怒气不断爆发， 他的忿怒永不止息。

verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not relent. Because he pursued his brother with a sword and slaughtered the women of the land, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger tore perpetually, and he kept his wrath forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because he pursued his brother with the sword, And cast off all pity; His anger tore perpetually, And he kept his wrath forever.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "The people of Edom have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They chased down their relatives, the Israelites, with swords, showing them no mercy. In their rage, they slashed them continually and were unrelenting in their anger.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "For three offenses of Edom, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because he pursued his brother with the sword And stifled his compassion; His anger also tore continually, And he maintained his fury forever.

verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because he burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "The people of Moab have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They desecrated the bones of Edom’s king, burning them to ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "For three offenses of Moab, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because he burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not relent. Because he burned to ashes the bones of Edom’s king,

verses.textZh: 我必降火在摩押， 烧毁加略的堡垒； 在扰攘、吶喊、吹角声中， 摩押必被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必降火在摩押， 烧毁加略的堡垒； 在扰攘、吶喊、吹角声中， 摩押必被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要降火在摩押， 烧灭加略的宫殿。 摩押必在哄嚷呐喊吹角之中死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send fire on Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.
verses.textEnEsv: So I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the strongholds of Kerioth, and Moab shall die amid uproar, amid shouting and the sound of the trumpet;
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will send a fire upon Moab, And it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; Moab shall die with tumult, With shouting and trumpet sound.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will send down fire on the land of Moab, and all the fortresses in Kerioth will be destroyed. The people will fall in the noise of battle, as the warriors shout and the ram’s horn sounds.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will send fire upon Moab And it will consume the citadels of Kerioth; And Moab will die amid the panic of battle, Amid war cries and the sound of a trumpet.
verses.textEn: I will send fire on Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

verses.textZh: 我必剪除他的掌权者， 也把他所有的领袖一同杀死。’ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必剪除他的掌权者， 也把他所有的领袖一同杀死。’ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必剪除摩押中的审判者， 将其中的一切首领和他一同杀戮。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will cut off the ruler from its midst, and will kill all its princes with him," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will cut off the judge from its midst, And slay all its princes with him," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will destroy their king and slaughter all their princes," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also eliminate the judge from her midst And slay all her leaders with him," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘犹大三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他弃绝耶和华的律法， 不遵守他的典章； 反被他们列祖跟从的偶像， 使他们走错了路。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘犹大三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他弃绝耶和华的律法， 不遵守他的典章； 反被他们列祖跟从的偶像， 使他们走错了路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 犹大人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他们的刑罚； 因为他们厌弃耶和华的训诲， 不遵守他的律例。 他们列祖所随从虚假的偶像使他们走迷了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not relent. Because they have rejected the law of the Lord and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because they have rejected the law of the Lord , and have not kept his statutes, but their lies have led them astray, those after which their fathers walked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they have despised the law of the Lord, And have not kept His commandments. Their lies lead them astray, Lies which their fathers followed.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "The people of Judah have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They have rejected the instruction of the Lord , refusing to obey his decrees. They have been led astray by the same lies that deceived their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "For three offenses of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they rejected the Law of the Lord And have not kept His statutes; Their lies also have led them astray, Those which their fathers followed.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not relent. Because they have rejected the law of the Lord and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,

verses.textZh: 我必降火在犹大， 烧毁耶路撒冷的堡垒。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必降火在犹大， 烧毁耶路撒冷的堡垒。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要降火在犹大， 烧灭耶路撒冷的宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send fire on Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: So I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the strongholds of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will send a fire upon Judah, And it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNlt: So I will send down fire on Judah, and all the fortresses of Jerusalem will be destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will send fire upon Judah, And it will consume the citadels of Jerusalem."
verses.textEn: I will send fire on Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘以色列三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他为了银子卖义人， 为了一双鞋卖穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘以色列三番四次犯罪， 我必不收回惩罚他的命令； 因为他为了银子卖义人， 为了一双鞋卖穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 以色列人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他们的刑罚； 因他们为银子卖了义人， 为一双鞋卖了穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not relent. They sell the innocent for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because they sell the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals—
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment, Because they sell the righteous for silver, And the poor for a pair of sandals.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "The people of Israel have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They sell honorable people for silver and poor people for a pair of sandals.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "For three offenses of Israel, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they sell the righteous for money, And the needy for a pair of sandals.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not relent. They sell the innocent for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.

verses.textZh: 他们践踏穷人的头， 好象践踏地面的尘土； 他们把困苦人应有的权益夺去； 儿子和父亲与同一个女子亲近， 故意亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们践踏穷人的头， 好象践踏地面的尘土； 他们把困苦人应有的权益夺去； 儿子和父亲与同一个女子亲近， 故意亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见穷人头上所蒙的灰也都垂涎， 阻碍谦卑人的道路。 父子同一个女子行淫， 亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: those who trample the head of the poor into the dust of the earth and turn aside the way of the afflicted; a man and his father go in to the same girl, so that my holy name is profaned;
verses.textEnNkjv: They pant after the dust of the earth whichis on the head of the poor, And pervert the way of the humble. A man and his father go in to the same girl, To defile My holy name.
verses.textEnNlt: They trample helpless people in the dust and shove the oppressed out of the way. Both father and son sleep with the same woman, corrupting my holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: "These who trample the head of the helpless to the dust of the earth Also divert the way of the humble; And a man and his father resort to the same girl So as to profane My holy name.
verses.textEn: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.

verses.textZh: 他们在各祭坛旁， 躺卧在别人抵押的衣服上面； 在他们神的殿中， 饮用拿剥削回来的钱所买的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在各祭坛旁， 躺卧在别人抵押的衣服上面； 在他们神的殿中， 饮用拿剥削回来的钱所买的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在各坛旁铺人所当的衣服，卧在其上， 又在他们神的庙中喝受罚之人的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.
verses.textEnEsv: they lay themselves down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge, and in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
verses.textEnNkjv: They lie down by every altar on clothes taken in pledge, And drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.textEnNlt: At their religious festivals, they lounge in clothing their debtors put up as security. In the house of their gods, they drink wine bought with unjust fines.
verses.textEnNasb: "And on garments seized as pledges they stretch out beside every altar, And in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
verses.textEn: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.

verses.textZh: 我不是在他们面前把亚摩利人消灭了吗？ 亚摩利人虽像香柏树高大， 像橡树那样坚固； 我却要灭绝它树上的果子， 拔除树下的根。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是在他们面前把亚摩利人消灭了吗？ 亚摩利人虽像香柏树高大， 像橡树那样坚固； 我却要灭绝它树上的果子， 拔除树下的根。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从以色列人面前除灭亚摩利人。 他虽高大如香柏树，坚固如橡树， 我却上灭他的果子，下绝他的根本。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them, though they were tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars and who was as strong as the oaks; I destroyed his fruit above and his roots beneath.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet itwas I who destroyed the Amorite before them, Whose height was like the height of the cedars, And he wasas strong as the oaks; Yet I destroyed his fruit above And his roots beneath.
verses.textEnNlt: "But as my people watched, I destroyed the Amorites, though they were as tall as cedars and as strong as oaks. I destroyed the fruit on their branches and dug out their roots.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, Though his height was like the height of cedars And he was as strong as the oaks; I also destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
verses.textEn: "Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them, though they were tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.

verses.textZh: 我不是带你们出埃及地， 领你们在旷野度过四十年， 叫你们得着亚摩利人的地为业吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是带你们出埃及地， 领你们在旷野度过四十年， 叫你们得着亚摩利人的地为业吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我也将你们从埃及地领上来， 在旷野引导你们四十年， 使你们得亚摩利人之地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: I brought you up out of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to give you the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: Also it was I who brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also itwas I who brought you up from the land of Egypt, And led you forty years through the wilderness, To possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.textEnNlt: It was I who rescued you from Egypt and led you through the desert for forty years, so you could possess the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it was I who brought you up from the land of Egypt, And led you in the wilderness for forty years So that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
verses.textEn: I brought you up out of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to give you the land of the Amorites.

verses.textZh: 我从你们子孙中兴起先知， 从年轻人中兴起拿细耳人； 以色列人哪！这不是事实吗？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从你们子孙中兴起先知， 从年轻人中兴起拿细耳人； 以色列人哪！这不是事实吗？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从你们子弟中兴起先知， 又从你们少年人中兴起拿细耳人。 以色列人哪，不是这样吗？ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I also raised up prophets from among your children and Nazirites from among your youths. Is this not true, people of Israel?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not indeed so, O people of Israel?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I raised up some of your sons as prophets, And some of your young men as Nazirites. Isit not so, O you children of Israel?" Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I chose some of your sons to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. Can you deny this, my people of Israel?" asks the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I raised up some of your sons to be prophets, And some of your young men to be Nazirites. Is this not so, you sons of Israel?" declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I also raised up prophets from among your children and Nazirites from among your youths. Is this not true, people of Israel?" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘但你们迫使拿细耳人喝酒， 吩咐先知说：不要说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘但你们迫使拿细耳人喝酒， 吩咐先知说：不要说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却给拿细耳人酒喝， 嘱咐先知说：不要说预言。
verses.textEnNiv: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
verses.textEnEsv: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, And commanded the prophets saying, ‘Do not prophesy!’
verses.textEnNlt: "But you caused the Nazirites to sin by making them drink wine, and you commanded the prophets, ‘Shut up!’
verses.textEnNasb: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine, And you commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy!’
verses.textEn: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要使你脚下的地摇荡， 好象满载禾捆的车子摇荡一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要使你脚下的地摇荡， 好象满载禾捆的车子摇荡一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，在你们所住之地，我必压你们， 如同装满禾捆的车压物一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I will press you down in your place, as a cart full of sheaves presses down.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am weighed down by you, As a cart full of sheaves is weighed down.
verses.textEnNlt: "So I will make you groan like a wagon loaded down with sheaves of grain.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am making a rut in the ground beneath you, Just as a wagon makes a rut when filled with sheaves.
verses.textEn: "Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.

verses.textZh: 行动迅速的不能逃走， 强而有力的不能施展他的勇力， 勇士也不能救自己；
verses.textZhCnvs: 行动迅速的不能逃走， 强而有力的不能施展他的勇力， 勇士也不能救自己；
verses.textZhCuv: 快跑的不能逃脱； 有力的不能用力； 刚勇的也不能自救。
verses.textEnNiv: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.
verses.textEnEsv: Flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not retain his strength, nor shall the mighty save his life;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore flight shall perish from the swift, The strong shall not strengthen his power, Nor shall the mighty deliver himself;
verses.textEnNlt: Your fastest runners will not get away. The strongest among you will become weak. Even mighty warriors will be unable to save themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: "Refuge will be lost from the swift, And the strong will not strengthen his power, Nor the warrior save his life.
verses.textEn: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.

verses.textZh: 拿弓的人站立不住， 跑得快的不能逃走， 骑马的也不能救自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弓的人站立不住， 跑得快的不能逃走， 骑马的也不能救自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弓的不能站立； 腿快的不能逃脱； 骑马的也不能自救。
verses.textEnNiv: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.
verses.textEnEsv: he who handles the bow shall not stand, and he who is swift of foot shall not save himself, nor shall he who rides the horse save his life;
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall not stand who handles the bow, The swift of foot shall not escape, Nor shall he who rides a horse deliver himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The archers will not stand their ground. The swiftest runners won’t be fast enough to escape. Even those riding horses won’t be able to save themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: "The one who grasps the bow will not stand his ground, The swift of foot will not escape, Nor will the one who rides the horse save his life.
verses.textEn: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.

verses.textZh: 到那日，最勇敢的战士， 也是赤身逃跑。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，最勇敢的战士， 也是赤身逃跑。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，勇士中最有胆量的， 必赤身逃跑。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and he who is stout of heart among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The most courageous men of might Shall flee naked in that day," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day the most courageous of your fighting men will drop their weapons and run for their lives," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Even the bravest among the warriors will flee naked on that day," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列人哪！要听耶和华攻击你们的这些话，就是攻击他从埃及地领上来的以色列全家，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人哪！要听耶和华攻击你们的这些话，就是攻击他从埃及地领上来的以色列全家，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，你们全家是我从埃及地领上来的，当听耶和华攻击你们的话：
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this word, people of Israel, the word the Lord has spoken against you—against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this word that the Lord has spoken against you, O people of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear this word that the Lord has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to this message that the Lord has spoken against you, O people of Israel—against the entire family I rescued from Egypt:
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this word which the Lord has spoken against you, sons of Israel, against the entire family which He brought up from the land of Egypt:
verses.textEn: Hear this word, people of Israel, the word the Lord has spoken against you—against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:

verses.textZh: "地上万族中， 我只拣选了你； 因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "地上万族中， 我只拣选了你； 因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在地上万族中，我只认识你们； 因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: "You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins."
verses.textEnEsv: "You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You only have I known of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities."
verses.textEnNlt: "From among all the families on the earth, I have been intimate with you alone. That is why I must punish you for all your sins."
verses.textEnNasb: "You only have I known among all the families of the earth; Therefore I will punish you for all your wrongdoing."
verses.textEn: "You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins."

verses.textZh: 二人如果没有约定， 怎会同行呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人如果没有约定， 怎会同行呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?
verses.textEnEsv: "Do two walk together, unless they have agreed to meet?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can two walk together, unless they are agreed?
verses.textEnNlt: Can two people walk together without agreeing on the direction?
verses.textEnNasb: Do two people walk together unless they have agreed to meet?
verses.textEn: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?

verses.textZh: 狮子如果不是捕获猎物， 怎会在林中吼叫？ 少壮狮子如果没有捕获甚么， 怎会在洞中咆哮呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子如果不是捕获猎物， 怎会在林中吼叫？ 少壮狮子如果没有捕获甚么， 怎会在洞中咆哮呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 狮子若非抓食，岂能在林中咆哮呢？ 少壮狮子若无所得，岂能从洞中发声呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Does a lion roar in the thicket when it has no prey? Does it growl in its den when it has caught nothing?
verses.textEnEsv: Does a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out from his den, if he has taken nothing?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey? Will a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
verses.textEnNlt: Does a lion ever roar in a thicket without first finding a victim? Does a young lion growl in its den without first catching its prey?
verses.textEnNasb: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl from his den unless he has captured something?
verses.textEn: Does a lion roar in the thicket when it has no prey? Does it growl in its den when it has caught nothing?

verses.textZh: 如果没有饵， 雀鸟怎会掉在地上的网罗中？ 网罗如果没有捕获雀鸟， 怎会从地上翻起呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果没有饵， 雀鸟怎会掉在地上的网罗中？ 网罗如果没有捕获雀鸟， 怎会从地上翻起呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若没有机槛，雀鸟岂能陷在网罗里呢？ 网罗若无所得，岂能从地上翻起呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Does a bird swoop down to a trap on the ground when no bait is there? Does a trap spring up from the ground if it has not caught anything?
verses.textEnEsv: Does a bird fall in a snare on the earth, when there is no trap for it? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when it has taken nothing?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will a bird fall into a snare on the earth, where there is no trap for it? Will a snare spring up from the earth, if it has caught nothing at all?
verses.textEnNlt: Does a bird ever get caught in a trap that has no bait? Does a trap spring shut when there’s nothing to catch?
verses.textEnNasb: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground when there is no device in it? Does a trap spring up from the earth when it captures nothing at all?
verses.textEn: Does a bird swoop down to a trap on the ground when no bait is there? Does a trap spring up from the ground if it has not caught anything?

verses.textZh: 城中如果吹起号角， 居民怎会不惊慌呢？ 灾祸如果临到某城， 不是耶和华所降的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中如果吹起号角， 居民怎会不惊慌呢？ 灾祸如果临到某城， 不是耶和华所降的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 城中若吹角，百姓岂不惊恐呢？ 灾祸若临到一城，岂非耶和华所降的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the Lord caused it?
verses.textEnEsv: Is a trumpet blown in a city, and the people are not afraid? Does disaster come to a city, unless the Lord has done it?
verses.textEnNkjv: If a trumpet is blown in a city, will not the people be afraid? If there is calamity in a city, will not the Lord have done it?
verses.textEnNlt: When the ram’s horn blows a warning, shouldn’t the people be alarmed? Does disaster come to a city unless the Lord has planned it?
verses.textEnNasb: If a trumpet is blown in a city, will the people not tremble? If a disaster occurs in a city, has the Lord not brought it about?
verses.textEn: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the Lord caused it?

verses.textZh: 如果主耶和华不先把计划向他的仆人众先知显示， 他就不会作任何事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果主耶和华不先把计划向他的仆人众先知显示， 他就不会作任何事。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华若不将奥秘指示他的仆人－众先知， 就一无所行。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the Sovereign Lord does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: "For the Lord God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the Lord God does nothing, Unless He reveals His secret to His servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: Indeed, the Sovereign Lord never does anything until he reveals his plans to his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly the Lord God does nothing Unless He reveals His secret plan To His servants the prophets.
verses.textEn: Surely the Sovereign Lord does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.

verses.textZh: 狮子吼叫，谁不害怕； 主耶和华宣告，谁敢不代他传话？
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子吼叫，谁不害怕； 主耶和华宣告，谁敢不代他传话？
verses.textZhCuv: 狮子吼叫，谁不惧怕呢？ 主耶和华发命，谁能不说预言呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Sovereign Lord has spoken— who can but prophesy?
verses.textEnEsv: The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken; who can but prophesy?"
verses.textEnNkjv: A lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken! Who can but prophesy?
verses.textEnNlt: The lion has roared— so who isn’t frightened? The Sovereign Lord has spoken— so who can refuse to proclaim his message?
verses.textEnNasb: A lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken! Who can do anything but prophesy?
verses.textEn: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Sovereign Lord has spoken— who can but prophesy?

verses.textZh: 要向亚实突和埃及的堡垒宣告："你们要在撒玛利亚山上聚集；观看城里极大的骚乱和城中的暴虐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要向亚实突和埃及的堡垒宣告："你们要在撒玛利亚山上聚集；观看城里极大的骚乱和城中的暴虐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要在亚实突的宫殿中 和埃及地的宫殿里传扬说： 你们要聚集在撒马利亚的山上， 就看见城中有何等大的扰乱与欺压的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people."
verses.textEnEsv: Proclaim to the strongholds in Ashdod and to the strongholds in the land of Egypt, and say, "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see the great tumults within her, and the oppressed in her midst."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, And in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: ‘Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; See great tumults in her midst, And the oppressed within her.
verses.textEnNlt: Announce this to the leaders of Philistia and to the great ones of Egypt: "Take your seats now on the hills around Samaria, and witness the chaos and oppression in Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Proclaim on the citadels in Ashdod and on the citadels in the land of Egypt and say, "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria and see the great panic within her and the oppressions in her midst.
verses.textEn: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people."

verses.textZh: "这些人不知道怎样行正直的事，只管在他们的堡垒中积聚暴行和欺压。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些人不知道怎样行正直的事，只管在他们的堡垒中积聚暴行和欺压。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些以强暴抢夺财物、 积蓄在自己家中的人 不知道行正直的事。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "They do not know how to do right," declares the Lord , "who store up in their fortresses what they have plundered and looted."
verses.textEnEsv: "They do not know how to do right," declares the Lord , "those who store up violence and robbery in their strongholds."
verses.textEnNkjv: For they do not know to do right,’ Says the Lord, ‘Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "My people have forgotten how to do right," says the Lord . "Their fortresses are filled with wealth taken by theft and violence.
verses.textEnNasb: But they do not know how to do what is right," declares the Lord, "these who store up violence and devastation in their citadels."
verses.textEn: "They do not know how to do right," declares the Lord , "who store up in their fortresses what they have plundered and looted."

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说： "敌人必围攻这地， 使你们的势力倾覆， 抢掠你们的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说： "敌人必围攻这地， 使你们的势力倾覆， 抢掠你们的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说： 敌人必来围攻这地， 使你的势力衰微， 抢掠你的家宅。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "An enemy will overrun your land, pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : "An adversary shall surround the land and bring down your defenses from you, and your strongholds shall be plundered."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "An adversary shallbe all around the land; He shall sap your strength from you, And your palaces shall be plundered."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore," says the Sovereign Lord , "an enemy is coming! He will surround them and shatter their defenses. Then he will plunder all their fortresses."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "An enemy, one surrounding the land, Will take down your fortifications from you, And your citadels will be looted."
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "An enemy will overrun your land, pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "牧人从狮子口中， 只能夺回一双羊腿和一角耳朵； 住在撒玛利亚的以色列人获救也是这样， 他们只剩下一角床榻，半边褥子 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "牧人从狮子口中， 只能夺回一双羊腿和一角耳朵； 住在撒玛利亚的以色列人获救也是这样， 他们只剩下一角床榻，半边褥子 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「牧人怎样从狮子口中抢回两条羊腿或半个耳朵，住撒马利亚的以色列人躺卧在床角上或铺绣花毯的榻上，他们得救也不过如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "As a shepherd rescues from the lion’s mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued, with only the head of a bed and a piece of fabric from a couch. "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "As the shepherd rescues from the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the people of Israel who dwell in Samaria be rescued, with the corner of a couch and part of a bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "As a shepherd takes from the mouth of a lion Two legs or a piece of an ear, So shall the children of Israel be taken out Who dwell in Samaria— In the corner of a bed and on the edge of a couch!
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "A shepherd who tries to rescue a sheep from a lion’s mouth will recover only two legs or a piece of an ear. So it will be for the Israelites in Samaria lying on luxurious beds, and for the people of Damascus reclining on couches.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Just as the shepherd snatches from the lion’s mouth a couple of legs or a piece of an ear, So will the sons of Israel living in Samaria be snatched away— With the corner of a bed and the cover of a couch!
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "As a shepherd rescues from the lion’s mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued, with only the head of a bed and a piece of fabric from a couch. "

verses.textZh: 你们要听，要向雅各家作证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要听，要向雅各家作证。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华－万军之神说： 当听这话，警戒雅各家。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob," declares the Lord, the Lord God Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear, and testify against the house of Jacob," declares the Lord God , the God of hosts,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob," Says the Lord God, the God of hosts,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now listen to this, and announce it throughout all Israel, " says the Lord, the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear and testify against the house of Jacob," Declares the Lord God, the God of armies.
verses.textEn: "Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob," declares the Lord, the Lord God Almighty.

verses.textZh: 我追讨以色列的悖逆时， 必要惩罚伯特利的祭坛； 坛角必砍下， 跌落在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我追讨以色列的悖逆时， 必要惩罚伯特利的祭坛； 坛角必砍下， 跌落在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我讨以色列罪的日子，也要讨伯特利祭坛的罪； 坛角必被砍下，坠落于地。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: "that on the day I punish Israel for his transgressions, I will punish the altars of Bethel, and the horns of the altar shall be cut off and fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: "That in the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will also visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; And the horns of the altar shall be cut off And fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the very day I punish Israel for its sins, I will destroy the pagan altars at Bethel. The horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "For on the day that I punish Israel’s offenses, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; The horns of the altar will be cut off, And will fall to the ground.
verses.textEn: "On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

verses.textZh: 我必毁坏冬天和夏天的别墅， 用象牙装饰的房子必破烂， 宏伟的楼宇必归于无有。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必毁坏冬天和夏天的别墅， 用象牙装饰的房子必破烂， 宏伟的楼宇必归于无有。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要拆毁过冬和过夏的房屋。 象牙的房屋也必毁灭； 高大的房屋都归无有。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will strike the winter house along with the summer house, and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall come to an end," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will destroy the winter house along with the summer house; The houses of ivory shall perish, And the great houses shall have an end," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will destroy the beautiful homes of the wealthy— their winter mansions and their summer houses, too— all their palaces filled with ivory," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also strike the winter house together with the summer house; The houses of ivory will also perish, And the great houses will come to an end," Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚山上的巴珊母牛啊！要听这话； 你们欺负贫穷人，压迫穷苦人， 又对自己的丈夫说："拿酒来，给我们饮用。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚山上的巴珊母牛啊！要听这话； 你们欺负贫穷人，压迫穷苦人， 又对自己的丈夫说："拿酒来，给我们饮用。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们住撒马利亚山如巴珊母牛的啊， 当听我的话－ 你们欺负贫寒的，压碎穷乏的， 对家主说：拿酒来，我们喝吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, "Bring us some drinks!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who say to your husbands, ‘Bring, that we may drink!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, Who oppress the poor, Who crush the needy, Who say to your husbands, "Bring wine, let us drink!"
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me, you fat cows living in Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, and who are always calling to your husbands, "Bring us another drink!"
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan who are on the mountain of Samaria, Who exploit the poor, who oppress the needy, And say to their husbands, "Bring now, that we may drink!"
verses.textEn: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, "Bring us some drinks!"

verses.textZh: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓： "看哪！对付你们的日子快到， 人必用钩子把你们钩走， 最后一个也必被人用鱼钩钩去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓： "看哪！对付你们的日子快到， 人必用钩子把你们钩走， 最后一个也必被人用鱼钩钩去。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓说： 日子快到，人必用钩子将你们钩去， 用鱼钩将你们余剩的钩去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by his holiness: "The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God has sworn by his holiness that, behold, the days are coming upon you, when they shall take you away with hooks, even the last of you with fishhooks.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God has sworn by His holiness: "Behold, the days shall come upon you When He will take you away with fishhooks, And your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord has sworn this by his holiness: "The time will come when you will be led away with hooks in your noses. Every last one of you will be dragged away like a fish on a hook!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God has sworn by His holiness, "For behold, the days are coming upon you When they will take you away with meat hooks, And the last of you with fish hooks.
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by his holiness: "The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.

verses.textZh: 你们一个一个经过城墙的破口出去， 被丢弃在哈门。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一个一个经过城墙的破口出去， 被丢弃在哈门。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们各人必从破口直往前行， 投入哈门。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will each go straight out through breaches in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon, " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall go out through the breaches, each one straight ahead; and you shall be cast out into Harmon," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You will go out through broken walls, Each one straight ahead of her, And you will be cast into Harmon," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be led out through the ruins of the wall; you will be thrown from your fortresses, " says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "You will go out through holes in the walls, One in front of the other, And you will be hurled to Harmon," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: You will each go straight out through breaches in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon, " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们去伯特利犯罪， 在吉甲增加过犯吧！ 每早献上你们的祭物， 每三日献上你们的十分之一吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们去伯特利犯罪， 在吉甲增加过犯吧！ 每早献上你们的祭物， 每三日献上你们的十分之一吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，任你们往伯特利去犯罪， 到吉甲加增罪过； 每日早晨献上你们的祭物， 每三日奉上你们的十分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come to Bethel, and transgress; to Gilgal, and multiply transgression; bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come to Bethel and transgress, At Gilgal multiply transgression; Bring your sacrifices every morning, Your tithes every three days.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go ahead and offer sacrifices to the idols at Bethel. Keep on disobeying at Gilgal. Offer sacrifices each morning, and bring your tithes every three days.
verses.textEnNasb: "Enter Bethel and do wrong; In Gilgal multiply wrongdoing! Bring your sacrifices every morning, Your tithes every three days.
verses.textEn: "Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.

verses.textZh: 以色列人哪！把有酵的饼作感谢祭献上， 高声宣扬你们自愿献的祭吧！ 这原是你们喜爱行的。" 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人哪！把有酵的饼作感谢祭献上， 高声宣扬你们自愿献的祭吧！ 这原是你们喜爱行的。" 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 任你们献有酵的感谢祭， 把甘心祭宣传报告给众人， 因为是你们所喜爱的。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings— boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do," declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim freewill offerings, publish them; for so you love to do, O people of Israel!" declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, Proclaim and announce the freewill offerings; For this you love, You children of Israel!" Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Present your bread made with yeast as an offering of thanksgiving. Then give your extra voluntary offerings so you can brag about it everywhere! This is the kind of thing you Israelites love to do," says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: " Offer a thanksgiving offering also from that which is leavened, And proclaim voluntary offerings, make them known. For so you love to do, you sons of Israel," Declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings— boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do," declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "虽然我使你们各城的人牙齿干净， 各处都缺乏粮食； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "虽然我使你们各城的人牙齿干净， 各处都缺乏粮食； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你们在一切城中牙齿干净， 在你们各处粮食缺乏， 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your places, yet you did not return to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And lack of bread in all your places; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I brought hunger to every city and famine to every town. But still you would not return to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "But I gave you also cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And lack of bread in all your places; Yet you have not returned to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我曾在收割前三个月， 不降雨给你们； 我降雨给一个城， 在另一个城却不降雨； 我在一块地降雨， 另一块地没有雨水就枯干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我曾在收割前三个月， 不降雨给你们； 我降雨给一个城， 在另一个城却不降雨； 我在一块地降雨， 另一块地没有雨水就枯干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止， 不降在你们那里； 我降雨在这城， 不降雨在那城； 这块地有雨， 那块地无雨； 无雨的就枯干了。
verses.textEnNiv: "I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.
verses.textEnEsv: "I also withheld the rain from you when there were yet three months to the harvest; I would send rain on one city, and send no rain on another city; one field would have rain, and the field on which it did not rain would wither;
verses.textEnNkjv: "I also withheld rain from you, When therewere still three months to the harvest. I made it rain on one city, I withheld rain from another city. One part was rained upon, And where it did not rain the part withered.
verses.textEnNlt: "I kept the rain from falling when your crops needed it the most. I sent rain on one town but withheld it from another. Rain fell on one field, while another field withered away.
verses.textEnNasb: "Furthermore, I withheld the rain from you While there were still three months until harvest. Then I would send rain on one city, But on another city I would not send rain; One part would be rained on, While the part not rained on would dry up.
verses.textEn: "I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.

verses.textZh: 两三个城的居民挤到一个城去找水喝， 却没有足够的水喝； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两三个城的居民挤到一个城去找水喝， 却没有足够的水喝； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，两三城的人凑到一城去找水， 却喝不足； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: so two or three cities would wander to another city to drink water, and would not be satisfied; yet you did not return to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So two or three cities wandered to another city to drink water, But they were not satisfied; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: People staggered from town to town looking for water, but there was never enough. But still you would not return to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "So the people of two or three cities would stagger to another city to drink water, But would not be satisfied; Yet you have not returned to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我曾多次用热风和霉烂击打你们的园子和葡萄园， 叫蝗虫吃光你们的无花果树和橄榄树； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我曾多次用热风和霉烂击打你们的园子和葡萄园， 叫蝗虫吃光你们的无花果树和橄榄树； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以旱风、霉烂攻击你们， 你们园中许多菜蔬、葡萄树、 无花果树、橄榄树都被剪虫所吃； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, destroying them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I struck you with blight and mildew; your many gardens and your vineyards, your fig trees and your olive trees the locust devoured; yet you did not return to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "I blasted you with blight and mildew. When your gardens increased, Your vineyards, Your fig trees, And your olive trees, The locust devoured them; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I struck your farms and vineyards with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured all your fig and olive trees. But still you would not return to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I struck you with scorching wind and mildew; The caterpillar was devouring Your many gardens and vineyards, fig trees and olive trees; Yet you have not returned to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, destroying them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我在你们中间降下瘟疫， 正如临到埃及的瘟疫一样； 我用刀杀掉你们的年轻人， 你们被掳去的马匹也遭杀戮； 我使你们营里死尸的臭气扑鼻， 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我在你们中间降下瘟疫， 正如临到埃及的瘟疫一样； 我用刀杀掉你们的年轻人， 你们被掳去的马匹也遭杀戮； 我使你们营里死尸的臭气扑鼻， 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我降瘟疫在你们中间， 像在埃及一样； 用刀杀戮你们的少年人， 使你们的马匹被掳掠， 营中尸首的臭气扑鼻； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I sent among you a pestilence after the manner of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, and carried away your horses, and I made the stench of your camp go up into your nostrils; yet you did not return to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "I sent among you a plague after the manner of Egypt; Your young men I killed with a sword, Along with your captive horses; I made the stench of your camps come up into your nostrils; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I sent plagues on you like the plagues I sent on Egypt long ago. I killed your young men in war and led all your horses away. The stench of death filled the air! But still you would not return to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I sent a plague among you as in Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses, And I made the stench of your camp rise up in your nostrils; Yet you have not returned to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我倾覆你们， 就像倾覆所多玛和蛾摩拉一样； 你们像一根木柴， 从火里抽出来； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我倾覆你们， 就像倾覆所多玛和蛾摩拉一样； 你们像一根木柴， 从火里抽出来； 但你们仍不归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我倾覆你们中间的城邑， 如同我从前倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉一样， 使你们好像从火中抽出来的一根柴； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I overthrew some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were as a brand plucked out of the burning; yet you did not return to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "I overthrew some of you, As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And you were like a firebrand plucked from the burning; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I destroyed some of your cities, as I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. Those of you who survived were like charred sticks pulled from a fire. But still you would not return to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I overthrew you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And you were like a log snatched from a fire; Yet you have not returned to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "因此，以色列啊！我必这样对付你。 以色列啊！因我必这样对付你， 你应当预备迎见你的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，以色列啊！我必这样对付你。 以色列啊！因我必这样对付你， 你应当预备迎见你的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行； 以色列啊，我既这样行， 你当预备迎见你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, Israel, prepare to meet your God."
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus I will do to you, O Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus will I do to you, O Israel; Because I will do this to you, Prepare to meet your God, O Israel!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, I will bring upon you all the disasters I have announced. Prepare to meet your God in judgment, you people of Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore so I will do to you, Israel; Because I will do this to you, Prepare to meet your God, Israel."
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, Israel, prepare to meet your God."

verses.textZh: 看哪！他造了山，创造了风， 把他的心意告诉人； 他使晨光变为黑暗， 他的脚踏在地的高处， 耶和华万军的神就是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他造了山，创造了风， 把他的心意告诉人； 他使晨光变为黑暗， 他的脚踏在地的高处， 耶和华万军的神就是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 那创山、造风、将心意指示人、 使晨光变为幽暗、脚踏在地之高处的， 他的名是耶和华－万军之神。
verses.textEnNiv: He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind, and who reveals his thoughts to mankind, who turns dawn to darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth— the Lord God Almighty is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, he who forms the mountains and creates the wind, and declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth— the Lord , the God of hosts, is his name!
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, He who forms mountains, And creates the wind, Who declares to man what his thought is, And makes the morning darkness, Who treads the high places of the earth— The Lord God of hosts is His name.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is the one who shaped the mountains, stirs up the winds, and reveals his thoughts to mankind. He turns the light of dawn into darkness and treads on the heights of the earth. The Lord God of Heaven’s Armies is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, He who forms mountains and creates the wind, And declares to a person what are His thoughts, He who makes dawn into darkness And treads on the high places of the earth, The Lord God of armies is His name.
verses.textEn: He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind, and who reveals his thoughts to mankind, who turns dawn to darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth— the Lord God Almighty is his name.

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！要听这话， 就是我为你们唱的挽歌：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！要听这话， 就是我为你们唱的挽歌：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家啊，要听我为你们所作的哀歌：
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this word, Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this word that I take up over you in lamentation, O house of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear this word which I take up against you, a lamentation, O house of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, you people of Israel! Listen to this funeral song I am singing:
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this word which I am taking up for you as a song of mourning, house of Israel:
verses.textEn: Hear this word, Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:

verses.textZh: "童贞女以色列， 跌倒了，不能再起来； 她被拋弃在自己的地上， 没有人扶她起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "童贞女以色列， 跌倒了，不能再起来； 她被拋弃在自己的地上， 没有人扶她起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列民 跌倒，不得再起； 躺在地上，无人搀扶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up."
verses.textEnEsv: "Fallen, no more to rise, is the virgin Israel; forsaken on her land, with none to raise her up."
verses.textEnNkjv: The virgin of Israel has fallen; She will rise no more. She lies forsaken on her land; Thereis no one to raise her up.
verses.textEnNlt: "The virgin Israel has fallen, never to rise again! She lies abandoned on the ground, with no one to help her up."
verses.textEnNasb: She has fallen, she will not rise again— The virgin Israel. She lies unnoticed on her land; There is no one to raise her up.
verses.textEn: "Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up."

verses.textZh: 因为主耶和华论以色列家这样说： "这城派兵一千， 剩下的只有一百； 出兵一百， 只剩下十个。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主耶和华论以色列家这样说： "这城派兵一千， 剩下的只有一百； 出兵一百， 只剩下十个。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 以色列家的城发出一千兵的，只剩一百； 发出一百的，只剩十个。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Israel: "Your city that marches out a thousand strong will have only a hundred left; your town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left."
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord God : "The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out a hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God: "The city that goes out by a thousand Shall have a hundred left, And that which goes out by a hundred Shall have ten left to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord says: "When a city sends a thousand men to battle, only a hundred will return. When a town sends a hundred, only ten will come back alive."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "The city which goes forth a thousand strong Will have a hundred left, And the one which goes forth a hundred strong Will have ten left to the house of Israel."
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Israel: "Your city that marches out a thousand strong will have only a hundred left; your town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对以色列家这样说： "寻求我，就必存活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对以色列家这样说： "寻求我，就必存活；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向以色列家如此说： 你们要寻求我，就必存活。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to Israel: "Seek me and live;
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord to the house of Israel: "Seek me and live;
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord to the house of Israel: "Seek Me and live;
verses.textEnNlt: Now this is what the Lord says to the family of Israel: "Come back to me and live!
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says to the house of Israel: "Seek Me so that you may live.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to Israel: "Seek me and live;

verses.textZh: 不要去伯特利寻求我， 不要去吉甲， 也不要过去别是巴。 因为吉甲必被掳掠， 伯特利必化为乌有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要去伯特利寻求我， 不要去吉甲， 也不要过去别是巴。 因为吉甲必被掳掠， 伯特利必化为乌有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不要往伯特利寻求， 不要进入吉甲， 不要过到别是巴； 因为吉甲必被掳掠， 伯特利也必归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing. "
verses.textEnEsv: but do not seek Bethel, and do not enter into Gilgal or cross over to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into exile, and Bethel shall come to nothing."
verses.textEnNkjv: But do not seek Bethel, Nor enter Gilgal, Nor pass over to Beersheba; For Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, And Bethel shall come to nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t worship at the pagan altars at Bethel; don’t go to the shrines at Gilgal or Beersheba. For the people of Gilgal will be dragged off into exile, and the people of Bethel will be reduced to nothing."
verses.textEnNasb: "But do not resort to Bethel And do not come to Gilgal, Nor cross over to Beersheba; For Gilgal will certainly go into captivity And Bethel will come to nothing.
verses.textEn: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing. "

verses.textZh: 寻求耶和华，就必存活， 免得他像火在约瑟家猛烈蔓延，吞灭他们； 没有人能把伯特利的火扑灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 寻求耶和华，就必存活， 免得他像火在约瑟家猛烈蔓延，吞灭他们； 没有人能把伯特利的火扑灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 要寻求耶和华，就必存活， 免得他在约瑟家像火发出， 在伯特利焚烧，无人扑灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Seek the Lord and live, or he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire; it will devour them, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek the Lord and live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, with none to quench it for Bethel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek the Lord and live, Lest He break out like fire in the house of Joseph, And devour it, With no one to quench it in Bethel—
verses.textEnNlt: Come back to the Lord and live! Otherwise, he will roar through Israel like a fire, devouring you completely. Your gods in Bethel won’t be able to quench the flames.
verses.textEnNasb: "Seek the Lord so that you may live, Or He will break through like a fire, house of Joseph, And it will consume with no one to extinguish it for Bethel,
verses.textEn: Seek the Lord and live, or he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire; it will devour them, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

verses.textZh: 他们使公正变为苦堇， 把公义弃于地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使公正变为苦堇， 把公义弃于地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这使公平变为茵陈、 将公义丢弃于地的，
verses.textEnNiv: There are those who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: O you who turn justice to wormwood and cast down righteousness to the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: You who turn justice to wormwood, And lay righteousness to rest in the earth!"
verses.textEnNlt: You twist justice, making it a bitter pill for the oppressed. You treat the righteous like dirt.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who turn justice into wormwood, And throw righteousness to the earth."
verses.textEn: There are those who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground.

verses.textZh: 那创造昴星和参星， 把幽暗变为黎明， 把白日转为黑夜； 又吩咐海水， 把海水倒在地上的； 耶和华就是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那创造昴星和参星， 把幽暗变为黎明， 把白日转为黑夜； 又吩咐海水， 把海水倒在地上的； 耶和华就是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 要寻求那造昴星和参星， 使死荫变为晨光， 使白日变为黑夜， 命海水来浇在地上的－ 耶和华是他的名；
verses.textEnNiv: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns midnight into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns deep darkness into the morning and darkens the day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the Lord is his name;
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the Pleiades and Orion; He turns the shadow of death into morning And makes the day dark as night; He calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the face of the earth; The Lordis His name.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the Lord who created the stars, the Pleiades and Orion. He turns darkness into morning and day into night. He draws up water from the oceans and pours it down as rain on the land. The Lord is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, And changes deep darkness into morning, Who also darkens day into night, Who calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the surface of the earth, The Lord is His name.
verses.textEn: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns midnight into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.

verses.textZh: 是他使毁灭像闪电临到堡垒， 使毁灭临到坚固的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是他使毁灭像闪电临到堡垒， 使毁灭临到坚固的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使力强的忽遭灭亡， 以致保障遭遇毁坏。
verses.textEnNiv: With a blinding flash he destroys the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: who makes destruction flash forth against the strong, so that destruction comes upon the fortress.
verses.textEnNkjv: He rains ruin upon the strong, So that fury comes upon the fortress.
verses.textEnNlt: With blinding speed and power he destroys the strong, crushing all their defenses.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who makes destruction flash upon the strong, So that destruction comes upon the fortress.
verses.textEn: With a blinding flash he destroys the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin.

verses.textZh: 他们讨厌那在城门口主持公道的人， 恨恶说正直话的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们讨厌那在城门口主持公道的人， 恨恶说正直话的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们怨恨那在城门口责备人的， 憎恶那说正直话的。
verses.textEnNiv: There are those who hate the one who upholds justice in court and detest the one who tells the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They hate the one who rebukes in the gate, And they abhor the one who speaks uprightly.
verses.textEnNlt: How you hate honest judges! How you despise people who tell the truth!
verses.textEnNasb: They hate him who rebukes in the gate, And they despise him who speaks with integrity.
verses.textEn: There are those who hate the one who upholds justice in court and detest the one who tells the truth.

verses.textZh: 你们欺压穷人， 强征他们的五谷； 因此，你们用琢磨过的石头建造房屋， 却不能住在其中； 你们栽种美好的葡萄园， 却不能喝园中的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们欺压穷人， 强征他们的五谷； 因此，你们用琢磨过的石头建造房屋， 却不能住在其中； 你们栽种美好的葡萄园， 却不能喝园中的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们践踏贫民， 向他们勒索麦子； 你们用凿过的石头建造房屋， 却不得住在其内； 栽种美好的葡萄园， 却不得喝所出的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: You levy a straw tax on the poor and impose a tax on their grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore because you trample on the poor and you exact taxes of grain from him, you have built houses of hewn stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, because you tread down the poor And take grain taxes from him, Though you have built houses of hewn stone, Yet you shall not dwell in them; You have planted pleasant vineyards, But you shall not drink wine from them.
verses.textEnNlt: You trample the poor, stealing their grain through taxes and unfair rent. Therefore, though you build beautiful stone houses, you will never live in them. Though you plant lush vineyards, you will never drink wine from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore because you impose heavy rent on the poor And take a tribute of grain from them, Though you have built houses of cut stone, Yet you will not live in them; You have planted beautiful vineyards, yet you will not drink their wine.
verses.textEn: You levy a straw tax on the poor and impose a tax on their grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道你们的过犯众多，罪大恶极； 你们迫害义人，收受贿赂， 在城门口屈枉穷乏人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道你们的过犯众多，罪大恶极； 你们迫害义人，收受贿赂， 在城门口屈枉穷乏人；
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道你们的罪过何等多， 你们的罪恶何等大。 你们苦待义人，收受贿赂，在城门口屈枉穷乏人。
verses.textEnNiv: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. There are those who oppress the innocent and take bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know how many are your transgressions and how great are your sins— you who afflict the righteous, who take a bribe, and turn aside the needy in the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know your manifold transgressions And your mighty sins: Afflicting the just and taking bribes; Diverting the poor fromjustice at the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: For I know the vast number of your sins and the depth of your rebellions. You oppress good people by taking bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.
verses.textEnNasb: For I know your offenses are many and your sins are great, You who are hostile to the righteous and accept bribes, And turn away the poor from justice at the gate.
verses.textEn: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. There are those who oppress the innocent and take bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.

verses.textZh: 为此，聪明人在这时代缄默无声， 因这时代邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为此，聪明人在这时代缄默无声， 因这时代邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以通达人见这样的时势必静默不言， 因为时势真恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the prudent keep quiet in such times, for the times are evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he who is prudent will keep silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the prudent keep silent at that time, For it is an evil time.
verses.textEnNlt: So those who are smart keep their mouths shut, for it is an evil time.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore at such a time the prudent person keeps quiet, because it is an evil time.
verses.textEn: Therefore the prudent keep quiet in such times, for the times are evil.

verses.textZh: 你们要寻求良善，不要寻求邪恶， 这样才可以存活。 耶和华万军的神就必与你们同在， 正如你们所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要寻求良善，不要寻求邪恶， 这样才可以存活。 耶和华万军的神就必与你们同在， 正如你们所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要求善， 不要求恶，就必存活。 这样，耶和华－万军之神 必照你们所说的与你们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the Lord , the God of hosts, will be with you, as you have said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek good and not evil, That you may live; So the Lord God of hosts will be with you, As you have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: Do what is good and run from evil so that you may live! Then the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies will be your helper, just as you have claimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek good and not evil, so that you may live; And so may the Lord God of armies be with you, Just as you have said!
verses.textEn: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.

verses.textZh: 你们要喜爱良善，恨恶邪恶， 在城门口伸张正义； 这样，耶和华万军的神或会恩待约瑟的余民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要喜爱良善，恨恶邪恶， 在城门口伸张正义； 这样，耶和华万军的神或会恩待约瑟的余民。
verses.textZhCuv: 要恶恶好善， 在城门口秉公行义； 或者耶和华－万军之神向约瑟的余民施恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the Lord God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: Hate evil, and love good, and establish justice in the gate; it may be that the Lord , the God of hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hate evil, love good; Establish justice in the gate. It may be that the Lord God of hosts Will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: Hate evil and love what is good; turn your courts into true halls of justice. Perhaps even yet the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies will have mercy on the remnant of his people.
verses.textEnNasb: Hate evil, love good, And establish justice in the gate! Perhaps the Lord God of armies Will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
verses.textEn: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the Lord God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华万军的神这样说： "各广场充满哀恸的声音， 街上只听见‘苦啊！苦啊！’的喊声； 人要召农夫来哀哭， 召善于哭丧的人来哀喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华万军的神这样说： "各广场充满哀恸的声音， 街上只听见‘苦啊！苦啊！’的喊声； 人要召农夫来哀哭， 召善于哭丧的人来哀喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华－万军之神如此说： 在一切宽阔处必有哀号的声音； 在各街市上必有人说： 哀哉！哀哉！ 又必叫农夫来哭号， 叫善唱哀歌的来举哀。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord God Almighty, says: "There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord , the God of hosts, the Lord: "In all the squares there shall be wailing, and in all the streets they shall say, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They shall call the farmers to mourning and to wailing those who are skilled in lamentation,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord God of hosts, the Lord, says this: "Thereshallbe wailing in all streets, And they shall say in all the highways, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They shall call the farmer to mourning, And skillful lamenters to wailing.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord, the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, says: "There will be crying in all the public squares and mourning in every street. Call for the farmers to weep with you, and summon professional mourners to wail.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God of armies, the Lord says: "There is mourning in all the public squares, And in all the streets they say, ‘Oh no! Oh no!’ They also call the farmer to mourning And professional mourners to mourning rites.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord God Almighty, says: "There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.

verses.textZh: 所有葡萄园充满哀恸的声音， 因为我必在你们中间经过。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有葡萄园充满哀恸的声音， 因为我必在你们中间经过。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在各葡萄园必有哀号的声音， 因为我必从你中间经过。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and in all vineyards there shall be wailing, for I will pass through your midst," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: In all vineyards thereshallbe wailing, For I will pass through you," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be wailing in every vineyard, for I will destroy them all," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "And in all the vineyards there is mourning, Because I will pass through the midst of you," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 渴望耶和华日子来临的人，你们有祸了！ 耶和华的日子对你们有甚么好处呢？ 那日是黑暗，没有光明的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 渴望耶和华日子来临的人，你们有祸了！ 耶和华的日子对你们有甚么好处呢？ 那日是黑暗，没有光明的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 想望耶和华日子来到的有祸了！ 你们为何想望耶和华的日子呢？ 那日黑暗没有光明，
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you who long for the day of the Lord ! Why do you long for the day of the Lord ? That day will be darkness, not light.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you who desire the day of the Lord ! Why would you have the day of the Lord ? It is darkness, and not light,
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you who desire the day of the Lord! For what good is the day of the Lord to you? It willbe darkness, and not light.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who say, "If only the day of the Lord were here!" You have no idea what you are wishing for. That day will bring darkness, not light.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you who are longing for the day of the Lord, For what purpose will the day of the Lordbe to you? It will be darkness and not light;
verses.textEn: Woe to you who long for the day of the Lord ! Why do you long for the day of the Lord ? That day will be darkness, not light.

verses.textZh: 那日就像一个人避过了狮子， 却遇上了熊； 回到家里，手靠在墙上， 却被蛇咬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日就像一个人避过了狮子， 却遇上了熊； 回到家里，手靠在墙上， 却被蛇咬。
verses.textZhCuv: 景况好像人躲避狮子又遇见熊， 或是进房屋以手靠墙，就被蛇咬。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.
verses.textEnEsv: as if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him, or went into the house and leaned his hand against the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.textEnNkjv: It willbe as though a man fled from a lion, And a bear met him! Or asthough he went into the house, Leaned his hand on the wall, And a serpent bit him!
verses.textEnNlt: In that day you will be like a man who runs from a lion— only to meet a bear. Escaping from the bear, he leans his hand against a wall in his house— and he’s bitten by a snake.
verses.textEnNasb: As when a man flees from a lion And a bear confronts him, Or he goes home, leans with his hand against the wall, And a snake bites him.
verses.textEn: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的日子不是黑暗，没有光明， 只有幽暗，全无光辉吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的日子不是黑暗，没有光明， 只有幽暗，全无光辉吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的日子不是黑暗没有光明吗？ 不是幽暗毫无光辉吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will not the day of the Lord be darkness, not light— pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not the day of the Lord darkness, and not light, and gloom with no brightness in it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not the day of the Lord darkness, and not light? Isitnot very dark, with no brightness in it?
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the day of the Lord will be dark and hopeless, without a ray of joy or hope.
verses.textEnNasb: Will the day of the Lord not be darkness instead of light, Even gloom with no brightness in it?
verses.textEn: Will not the day of the Lord be darkness, not light— pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?

verses.textZh: 我憎恨、厌恶你们的节期， 也不喜爱你们的节日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我憎恨、厌恶你们的节期， 也不喜爱你们的节日。
verses.textZhCuv: 我厌恶你们的节期， 也不喜悦你们的严肃会。
verses.textEnNiv: "I hate, I despise your religious festivals; your assemblies are a stench to me.
verses.textEnEsv: "I hate, I despise your feasts, and I take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I hate, I despise your feast days, And I do not savor your sacred assemblies.
verses.textEnNlt: "I hate all your show and pretense— the hypocrisy of your religious festivals and solemn assemblies.
verses.textEnNasb: "I hate, I reject your festivals, Nor do I delight in your festive assemblies.
verses.textEn: "I hate, I despise your religious festivals; your assemblies are a stench to me.

verses.textZh: 虽然你们给我献上燔祭和素祭， 我却不接受。 你们献上肥美的牲畜作平安祭， 我也不悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然你们给我献上燔祭和素祭， 我却不接受。 你们献上肥美的牲畜作平安祭， 我也不悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们虽然向我献燔祭和素祭， 我却不悦纳， 也不顾你们用肥畜献的平安祭；
verses.textEnNiv: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Even though you offer me your burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; and the peace offerings of your fattened animals, I will not look upon them.
