verses.textEnNkjv: Though you offer Me burnt offerings and your grain offerings, I will not accept them, Nor will I regard your fattened peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: I will not accept your burnt offerings and grain offerings. I won’t even notice all your choice peace offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even though you offer up to Me burnt offerings and your grain offerings, I will not accept them; And I will not even look at the peace offerings of your fattened oxen.
verses.textEn: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.

verses.textZh: 你们唱歌的吵声要远离我， 我不想听见你们的琴声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们唱歌的吵声要远离我， 我不想听见你们的琴声。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使你们歌唱的声音远离我， 因为我不听你们弹琴的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
verses.textEnEsv: Take away from me the noise of your songs; to the melody of your harps I will not listen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take away from Me the noise of your songs, For I will not hear the melody of your stringed instruments.
verses.textEnNlt: Away with your noisy hymns of praise! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take away from Me the noise of your songs; I will not even listen to the sound of your harps.
verses.textEn: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

verses.textZh: 但愿公正好象潮水滚流， 公义好象河水长流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿公正好象潮水滚流， 公义好象河水长流。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚， 使公义如江河滔滔。
verses.textEnNiv: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verses.textEnEsv: But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let justice run down like water, And righteousness like a mighty stream.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, I want to see a mighty flood of justice, an endless river of righteous living.
verses.textEnNasb: "But let justice roll out like waters, And righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
verses.textEn: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！你们在旷野四十年， 有献燔祭和素祭给我吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！你们在旷野四十年， 有献燔祭和素祭给我吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列家啊，你们在旷野四十年，岂是将祭物和供物献给我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: "Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings during the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Did you offer Me sacrifices and offerings In the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: "Was it to me you were bringing sacrifices and offerings during the forty years in the wilderness, Israel?
verses.textEnNasb: " Did you present Me with sacrifices and grain offerings in the wilderness for forty years, house of Israel?
verses.textEn: "Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

verses.textZh: 你们抬着你们的神"撒固"王，和你们的星神"迦温"的神像，就是你们为自己所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们抬着你们的神"撒固"王，和你们的星神"迦温"的神像，就是你们为自己所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们抬着为自己所造之摩洛的帐幕和偶像的龛，并你们的神星。
verses.textEnNiv: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god — which you made for yourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall take up Sikkuth your king, and Kiyyun your star-god—your images that you made for yourselves,
verses.textEnNkjv: You also carried Sikkuth your king And Chiun, your idols, The star of your gods, Which you made for yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: No, you served your pagan gods—Sakkuth your king god and Kaiwan your star god—the images you made for yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: You also carried along Sikkuth your king and Kiyyun, your images, the star of your gods which you made for yourselves.
verses.textEn: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god — which you made for yourselves.

verses.textZh: 我必使你们被掳，流亡到大马士革以外。这是耶和华说的，万军的神就是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们被掳，流亡到大马士革以外。这是耶和华说的，万军的神就是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我要把你们掳到大马士革以外。」这是耶和华、名为万军之神说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the Lord , whose name is God Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the Lord , whose name is the God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will send you into captivity beyond Damascus," Says the Lord, whose name is the God of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will send you into exile, to a land east of Damascus, " says the Lord , whose name is the God of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I will make you go into exile beyond Damascus," says the Lord, whose name is the God of armies.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the Lord , whose name is God Almighty.

verses.textZh: 那些在锡安平静安逸的， 安稳在撒玛利亚山上的，有祸了！ 你们是这列国中为首之大国的领袖， 是以色列家所归向的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些在锡安平静安逸的， 安稳在撒玛利亚山上的，有祸了！ 你们是这列国中为首之大国的领袖， 是以色列家所归向的。
verses.textZhCuv: 国为列国之首，人最著名， 且为以色列家所归向， 在锡安和撒马利亚山安逸无虑的，有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who feel secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the first of the nations, to whom the house of Israel comes!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you whoare at ease in Zion, And trust in Mount Samaria, Notable persons in the chief nation, To whom the house of Israel comes!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who lounge in luxury in Jerusalem, and you who feel secure in Samaria! You are famous and popular in Israel, and people go to you for help.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who are carefree in Zion, And to those who feel secure on the mountain of Samaria, The dignitaries of the foremost of nations, To whom the house of Israel comes.
verses.textEn: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!

verses.textZh: 你们要过去甲尼看看， 从那里往哈马大城去， 然后下到非利士的迦特； 看你们是否比这些国家胜一筹？ 他们的领土是否比你们的领土还大？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要过去甲尼看看， 从那里往哈马大城去， 然后下到非利士的迦特； 看你们是否比这些国家胜一筹？ 他们的领土是否比你们的领土还大？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要过到甲尼察看， 从那里往大城哈马去， 又下到非利士人的迦特， 看那些国比你们的国还强吗？ 境界比你们的境界还宽吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Go to Kalneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?
verses.textEnEsv: Pass over to Calneh, and see, and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Or is their territory greater than your territory,
verses.textEnNkjv: Go over to Calneh and see; And from there go to Hamath the great; Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Areyou better than these kingdoms? Or is their territory greater than your territory?
verses.textEnNlt: But go over to Calneh and see what happened there. Then go to the great city of Hamath and down to the Philistine city of Gath. You are no better than they were, and look at how they were destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Go over to Calneh and look, And go from there to Hamath the great, Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms, Or is their territory greater than yours?
verses.textEn: Go to Kalneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?

verses.textZh: 你们认为灾祸的日子离开很远， 你们的行为却招致残暴的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们认为灾祸的日子离开很远， 你们的行为却招致残暴的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们以为降祸的日子还远， 坐在位上尽行强暴 。
verses.textEnNiv: You put off the day of disaster and bring near a reign of terror.
verses.textEnEsv: O you who put far away the day of disaster and bring near the seat of violence?
verses.textEnNkjv: Woeto you who put far off the day of doom, Who cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.textEnNlt: You push away every thought of coming disaster, but your actions only bring the day of judgment closer.
verses.textEnNasb: Are you postponing the day of disaster, And would you bring near the seat of violence?
verses.textEn: You put off the day of disaster and bring near a reign of terror.

verses.textZh: 你们卧在象牙床上， 躺在榻上； 你们吃羊群中的羊羔， 和牛棚里的牛犊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们卧在象牙床上， 躺在榻上； 你们吃羊群中的羊羔， 和牛棚里的牛犊。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们躺卧在象牙床上，舒身在榻上， 吃群中的羊羔，棚里的牛犊；
verses.textEnNiv: You lie on beds adorned with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to those who lie on beds of ivory and stretch themselves out on their couches, and eat lambs from the flock and calves from the midst of the stall,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who lie on beds of ivory, Stretch out on your couches, Eat lambs from the flock And calves from the midst of the stall;
verses.textEnNlt: How terrible for you who sprawl on ivory beds and lounge on your couches, eating the meat of tender lambs from the flock and of choice calves fattened in the stall.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who lie on beds of ivory, And lounge around on their couches, And eat lambs from the flock, And calves from the midst of the fattened cattle,
verses.textEn: You lie on beds adorned with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.

verses.textZh: 你们闲逸地弹琴奏乐， 又为自己制造乐器，像大卫一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们闲逸地弹琴奏乐， 又为自己制造乐器，像大卫一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 弹琴鼓瑟唱消闲的歌曲， 为自己制造乐器，如同大卫所造的；
verses.textEnNiv: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.
verses.textEnEsv: who sing idle songs to the sound of the harp and like David invent for themselves instruments of music,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who sing idly to the sound of stringed instruments, And invent for yourselves musical instruments like David;
verses.textEnNlt: You sing trivial songs to the sound of the harp and fancy yourselves to be great musicians like David.
verses.textEnNasb: Who improvise to the sound of the harp, And like David have composed songs for themselves,
verses.textEn: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.

verses.textZh: 你们用大碗喝酒， 用最贵重的膏油抹身； 但你们并没有为约瑟的败落而痛心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们用大碗喝酒， 用最贵重的膏油抹身； 但你们并没有为约瑟的败落而痛心。
verses.textZhCuv: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身， 却不为约瑟的苦难担忧。
verses.textEnNiv: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: who drink wine in bowls and anoint themselves with the finest oils, but are not grieved over the ruin of Joseph!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who drink wine from bowls, And anoint yourselves with the best ointments, But are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: You drink wine by the bowlful and perfume yourselves with fragrant lotions. You care nothing about the ruin of your nation.
verses.textEnNasb: Who drink wine from sacred bowls While they anoint themselves with the finest of oils— Yet they have not grieved over the collapse of Joseph.
verses.textEn: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们将是最先被掳去的人， 宴乐享受的日子必要消逝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们将是最先被掳去的人， 宴乐享受的日子必要消逝。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以这些人必在被掳的人中首先被掳； 舒身的人荒宴之乐必消灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they shall now be the first of those who go into exile, and the revelry of those who stretch themselves out shall pass away."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they shall now go captive as the first of the captives, And those who recline at banquets shall be removed.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, you will be the first to be led away as captives. Suddenly, all your parties will end.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, they will now go into exile at the head of the exiles, And the revelry of those who lounge around will come to an end.
verses.textEn: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华指着自己起誓说： "我痛恨雅各所夸耀的， 憎恶他的堡垒； 我要把城市和城中的一切， 都交给敌人。"这是耶和华万军的神的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华指着自己起誓说： "我痛恨雅各所夸耀的， 憎恶他的堡垒； 我要把城市和城中的一切， 都交给敌人。"这是耶和华万军的神的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华－万军之神指着自己起誓说： 我憎恶雅各的荣华，厌弃他的宫殿； 因此，我必将城和其中所有的都交付敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by himself—the Lord God Almighty declares: "I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God has sworn by himself, declares the Lord , the God of hosts: "I abhor the pride of Jacob and hate his strongholds, and I will deliver up the city and all that is in it."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God has sworn by Himself, The Lord God of hosts says: "I abhor the pride of Jacob, And hate his palaces; Therefore I will deliver up the city And all that is in it."
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by his own name, and this is what he, the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, says: "I despise the arrogance of Israel, and I hate their fortresses. I will give this city and everything in it to their enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God has sworn by Himself, the Lord God of armies has declared: "I loathe the arrogance of Jacob, And detest his citadels; Therefore I will give up the city and all it contains."
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by himself—the Lord God Almighty declares: "I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it."

verses.textZh: 如果在一间房子里剩下十个人，他们都必死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果在一间房子里剩下十个人，他们都必死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，若在一房之内剩下十个人，也都必死。
verses.textEnNiv: If ten people are left in one house, they too will die.
verses.textEnEsv: And if ten men remain in one house, they shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall come to pass, that if ten men remain in one house, they shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: (If there are ten men left in one house, they will all die.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be, if ten men are left in one house, they will die.
verses.textEn: If ten people are left in one house, they too will die.

verses.textZh: 死者的亲属和殓葬的人把尸体从房子抬走，并问那躲在屋内深处的人："还有人吗？"那人回答："没有，不要再说话，不可再提耶和华的名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 死者的亲属和殓葬的人把尸体从房子抬走，并问那躲在屋内深处的人："还有人吗？"那人回答："没有，不要再说话，不可再提耶和华的名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 死人的伯叔，就是烧他尸首的，要将这尸首搬到房外，问房屋内间的人说：「你那里还有人没有？」他必说：「没有」；又说：「不要作声，因为我们不可提耶和华的名。」
verses.textEnNiv: And if the relative who comes to carry the bodies out of the house to burn them asks anyone who might be hiding there, "Is anyone else with you?" and he says, "No," then he will go on to say, "Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And when one’s relative, the one who anoints him for burial, shall take him up to bring the bones out of the house, and shall say to him who is in the innermost parts of the house, "Is there still anyone with you?" he shall say, "No"; and he shall say, "Silence! We must not mention the name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when a relative ofthedead, with one who will burn thebodies, picks up the bodies to take them out of the house, he will say to one inside the house, "Arethere any more with you?" Then someone will say, "None." And he will say, "Hold your tongue! For we dare not mention the name of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: And when a relative who is responsible to dispose of the dead goes into the house to carry out the bodies, he will ask the last survivor, "Is anyone else with you?" When the person begins to swear, "No, by . . . ," he will interrupt and say, "Stop! Don’t even mention the name of the Lord .")
verses.textEnNasb: Then one’s uncle, or his undertaker, will lift him up to carry out his bones from the house, and he will say to the one who is in the innermost part of the house, "Is anyone else with you?" And that one will say, "No one." Then he will answer, "Keep quiet! For the name of the Lord is not to be mentioned."
verses.textEn: And if the relative who comes to carry the bodies out of the house to burn them asks anyone who might be hiding there, "Is anyone else with you?" and he says, "No," then he will go on to say, "Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华下令，大楼就粉碎， 小屋也要破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华下令，大楼就粉碎， 小屋也要破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华出令， 大房就被攻破， 小屋就被打裂。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the Lord commands, and the great house shall be struck down into fragments, and the little house into bits.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the Lord gives a command: He will break the great house into bits, And the little house into pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord gives the command, homes both great and small will be smashed to pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, the Lord is going to command that the great house be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.
verses.textEn: For the Lord has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.

verses.textZh: 马会在悬崖奔驰吗？ 人会用牛耙海吗？ 但你使公正变为毒草， 使公义的果子转为苦堇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马会在悬崖奔驰吗？ 人会用牛耙海吗？ 但你使公正变为毒草， 使公义的果子转为苦堇。
verses.textZhCuv: 马岂能在崖石上奔跑？ 人岂能在那里用牛耕种呢？ 你们却使公平变为苦胆， 使公义的果子变为茵陈。
verses.textEnNiv: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness—
verses.textEnEsv: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood —
verses.textEnNkjv: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow there with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into gall, And the fruit of righteousness into wormwood,
verses.textEnNlt: Can horses gallop over boulders? Can oxen be used to plow them? But that’s how foolish you are when you turn justice into poison and the sweet fruit of righteousness into bitterness.
verses.textEnNasb: Do horses run on rocks? Or does one plow them with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into poison, And the fruit of righteousness into wormwood,
verses.textEn: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness—

verses.textZh: 你们以夺取罗底巴为夸耀， 说："我们夺取加宁不是靠自己的力量吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们以夺取罗底巴为夸耀， 说："我们夺取加宁不是靠自己的力量吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们喜爱虚浮的事，自夸说： 我们不是凭自己的力量取了角吗？
verses.textEnNiv: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar and say, "Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?"
verses.textEnEsv: you who rejoice in Lo-debar, who say, "Have we not by our own strength captured Karnaim for ourselves?"
verses.textEnNkjv: You who rejoice over Lo Debar, Who say, "Have we not taken Karnaim for ourselves By our own strength?"
verses.textEnNlt: And you brag about your conquest of Lo-debar. You boast, "Didn’t we take Karnaim by our own strength?"
verses.textEnNasb: You who rejoice in Lodebar, And say, "Have we not by our own strength taken Karnaim for ourselves?"
verses.textEn: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar and say, "Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?"

verses.textZh: "看哪！以色列家， 我要兴起一国攻击你们， 这国要欺压你们， 从哈马关口直至亚拉巴河。" 这是万军耶和华神的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！以色列家， 我要兴起一国攻击你们， 这国要欺压你们， 从哈马关口直至亚拉巴河。" 这是万军耶和华神的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华、万军之神说： 以色列家啊，我必兴起一国攻击你们； 他们必欺压你们， 从哈马口直到亚拉巴的河。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord God Almighty declares, "I will stir up a nation against you, Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah."
verses.textEnEsv: "For behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel," declares the Lord , the God of hosts; "and they shall oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But, behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel," Says the Lord God of hosts; "And they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath To the Valley of the Arabah."
verses.textEnNlt: "O people of Israel, I am about to bring an enemy nation against you," says the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies. "They will oppress you throughout your land— from Lebo-hamath in the north to the Arabah Valley in the south."
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I am going to raise up a nation against you, House of Israel," declares the Lord God of armies, "And they will torment you from the entrance of Hamath To the brook of the Arabah."
verses.textEn: For the Lord God Almighty declares, "I will stir up a nation against you, Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华向我这样显示：看哪！替王收割之后，田产又开始生长时，主造出一群蝗虫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华向我这样显示：看哪！替王收割之后，田产又开始生长时，主造出一群蝗虫。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华指示我一件事：为王割菜 之后，菜又发生；刚发生的时候，主造蝗虫。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king’s share had been harvested and just as the late crops were coming up.
verses.textEnEsv: This is what the Lord God showed me: behold, he was forming locusts when the latter growth was just beginning to sprout, and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the Lord God showed me: Behold, He formed locust swarms at the beginning of the late crop; indeed itwas the late crop after the king’s mowings.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord showed me a vision. I saw him preparing to send a vast swarm of locusts over the land. This was after the king’s share had been harvested from the fields and as the main crop was coming up.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God showed me, and behold, He was forming a swarm of locusts when the spring crop began to sprout. And behold, the spring crop was after the king’s mowing.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king’s share had been harvested and just as the late crops were coming up.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫吃尽地上的农产时，我说： "主耶和华啊！求你宽恕， 因雅各太弱小， 怎能站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫吃尽地上的农产时，我说： "主耶和华啊！求你宽恕， 因雅各太弱小， 怎能站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 蝗虫吃尽那地的青物，我就说：「主耶和华啊，求你赦免；因为雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, "Sovereign Lord , forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"
verses.textEnEsv: When they had finished eating the grass of the land, I said, "O Lord God , please forgive! How can Jacob stand? He is so small!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when they had finished eating the grass of the land, that I said: "O Lord God, forgive, I pray! Oh, that Jacob may stand, For he is small!"
verses.textEnNlt: In my vision the locusts ate every green plant in sight. Then I said, "O Sovereign Lord , please forgive us or we will not survive, for Israel is so small."
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when it had finished eating the vegetation of the land, that I said, "Lord God, please pardon! How can Jacob stand? For he is small."
verses.textEn: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, "Sovereign Lord , forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对这事改变心意， 耶和华说："这事不会发生。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对这事改变心意， 耶和华说："这事不会发生。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就后悔说：「这灾可以免了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord relented. "This will not happen," the Lord said.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord relented concerning this: "It shall not be," said the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord relented concerning this. "It shall not be," said the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord relented from this plan. "I will not do it," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord relented of this. "It shall not be," said the Lord.
verses.textEn: So the Lord relented. "This will not happen," the Lord said.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华向我这样显示：看哪！主耶和华召来刑罚的火，烧毁广大的深渊和以色列的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华向我这样显示：看哪！主耶和华召来刑罚的火，烧毁广大的深渊和以色列的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华又指示我一件事：他命火来惩罚以色列，火就吞灭深渊，险些将地烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: The Sovereign Lord was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.
verses.textEnEsv: This is what the Lord God showed me: behold, the Lord God was calling for a judgment by fire, and it devoured the great deep and was eating up the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the Lord God showed me: Behold, the Lord God called for conflict by fire, and it consumed the great deep and devoured the territory.

verses.textEnNasb: Hear this, you who trample the needy, to put an end to the humble of the land,
verses.textEn: Hear this, you who trample the needy and do away with the poor of the land,

verses.textZh: 你们说： "月朔甚么时候过去， 好让我们可以卖五谷； 安息日甚么时候结束， 好让我们可以开市卖谷物。 我们卖东西就把升斗弄小， 收银子却用加重了的法码， 我们要用假秤欺骗人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说： "月朔甚么时候过去， 好让我们可以卖五谷； 安息日甚么时候结束， 好让我们可以开市卖谷物。 我们卖东西就把升斗弄小， 收银子却用加重了的法码， 我们要用假秤欺骗人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们说：月朔几时过去， 我们好卖粮； 安息日几时过去， 我们好摆开麦子； 卖出用小升斗， 收银用大戥子， 用诡诈的天平欺哄人，
verses.textEnNiv: saying, "When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?"— skimping on the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "When will the new moon be over, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may offer wheat for sale, that we may make the ephah small and the shekel great and deal deceitfully with false balances,
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying: "When will the New Moon be past, That we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, That we may trade wheat? Making the ephah small and the shekel large, Falsifying the scales by deceit,
verses.textEnNlt: You can’t wait for the Sabbath day to be over and the religious festivals to end so you can get back to cheating the helpless. You measure out grain with dishonest measures and cheat the buyer with dishonest scales.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "When will the new moon be over, So that we may sell grain; And the Sabbath, so that we may open the wheat market, To make the ephah smaller and the shekel bigger, And to cheat with dishonest scales,
verses.textEn: saying, "When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?"— skimping on the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,

verses.textZh: 我们用银子买穷人， 用一双鞋换取穷乏人； 连麦碎也卖掉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们用银子买穷人， 用一双鞋换取穷乏人； 连麦碎也卖掉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 好用银子买贫寒人， 用一双鞋换穷乏人， 将坏了的麦子卖给人。
verses.textEnNiv: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.
verses.textEnEsv: that we may buy the poor for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals and sell the chaff of the wheat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: That we may buy the poor for silver, And the needy for a pair of sandals— Even sell the bad wheat?"
verses.textEnNlt: And you mix the grain you sell with chaff swept from the floor. Then you enslave poor people for one piece of silver or a pair of sandals.
verses.textEnNasb: So as to buy the helpless for money, And the needy for a pair of sandals, And that we may sell the refuse of the wheat?"
verses.textEn: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.

verses.textZh: 耶和华指着雅各所夸耀的起誓说： "我必永远记着他们所作的一切；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华指着雅各所夸耀的起誓说： "我必永远记着他们所作的一切；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华指着雅各的荣耀起誓说： 他们的一切行为，我必永远不忘。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has sworn by himself, the Pride of Jacob: "I will never forget anything they have done.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has sworn by the pride of Jacob: "Surely I will never forget any of their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has sworn by the pride of Jacob: "Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord has sworn this oath by his own name, the Pride of Israel : "I will never forget the wicked things you have done!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has sworn by the pride of Jacob, "Indeed, I will never forget any of their deeds.
verses.textEn: The Lord has sworn by himself, the Pride of Jacob: "I will never forget anything they have done.

verses.textZh: "这地不应为此震动， 所有住在地上的不应悲哀吗？ 这地必像尼罗河高涨翻腾， 像埃及的大河退落。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这地不应为此震动， 所有住在地上的不应悲哀吗？ 这地必像尼罗河高涨翻腾， 像埃及的大河退落。
verses.textZhCuv: 地岂不因这事震动？ 其上的居民不也悲哀吗？ 地必全然像尼罗河涨起， 如同埃及河涌上落下。
verses.textEnNiv: "Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Shall not the land tremble on this account, and everyone mourn who dwells in it, and all of it rise like the Nile, and be tossed about and sink again, like the Nile of Egypt?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall the land not tremble for this, And everyone mourn who dwells in it? All of it shall swell like the River, Heave and subside Like the River of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth will tremble for your deeds, and everyone will mourn. The ground will rise like the Nile River at floodtime; it will heave up, then sink again.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of this will the land not quake, And everyone who lives in it mourn? Indeed, all of it will rise up like the Nile, And it will be tossed about And subside like the Nile of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.

verses.textZh: "到那日，这是耶和华的宣告： 我必使太阳在正午落下， 在白昼使地变成昏暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，这是耶和华的宣告： 我必使太阳在正午落下， 在白昼使地变成昏暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：到那日， 我必使日头在午间落下， 使地在白昼黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Sovereign Lord , "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.
verses.textEnEsv: "And on that day," declares the Lord God , "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall come to pass in that day," says the Lord God, "That I will make the sun go down at noon, And I will darken the earth in broad daylight;
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Sovereign Lord , "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth while it is still day.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about on that day," declares the Lord God, "That I will make the sun go down at noon, And make the earth dark in broad daylight.
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Sovereign Lord , "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

verses.textZh: "我必使你们欢乐的节期变为悲哀的日子， 把你们的歌声都变为哀哭。 我必使你们各人腰束麻带， 头都剃光了； 我必使你们悲哀，好象丧了独生子， 自始至终都是痛苦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必使你们欢乐的节期变为悲哀的日子， 把你们的歌声都变为哀哭。 我必使你们各人腰束麻带， 头都剃光了； 我必使你们悲哀，好象丧了独生子， 自始至终都是痛苦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你们的节期变为悲哀， 歌曲变为哀歌。 众人腰束麻布，头上光秃， 使这场悲哀如丧独生子， 至终如痛苦的日子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn your religious festivals into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.
verses.textEnEsv: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation; I will bring sackcloth on every waist and baldness on every head; I will make it like the mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will turn your feasts into mourning, And all your songs into lamentation; I will bring sackcloth on every waist, And baldness on every head; I will make it like mourning for an only son, And its end like a bitter day.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn your celebrations into times of mourning and your singing into weeping. You will wear funeral clothes and shave your heads to show your sorrow— as if your only son had died. How very bitter that day will be!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will turn your festivals into mourning, And all your songs into songs of mourning; And I will put sackcloth around everyone’s waist, And baldness on every head. And I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, And the end of it will be like a bitter day.
verses.textEn: I will turn your religious festivals into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到，这是主耶和华的宣告。 我必使饥荒临到这地， 这饥荒不是因为没有食物， 这干渴不是因为没有水； 而是因为听不见耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到，这是主耶和华的宣告。 我必使饥荒临到这地， 这饥荒不是因为没有食物， 这干渴不是因为没有水； 而是因为听不见耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：日子将到， 我必命饥荒降在地上。 人饥饿非因无饼，干渴非因无水， 乃因不听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Sovereign Lord , "when I will send a famine through the land— not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord God , "when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming," says the Lord God, "That I will send a famine on the land, Not a famine of bread, Nor a thirst for water, But of hearing the words of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "The time is surely coming," says the Sovereign Lord , "when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or water but of hearing the words of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, days are coming," declares the Lord God, "When I will send a famine on the land, Not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, But rather for hearing the words of the Lord.
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Sovereign Lord , "when I will send a famine through the land— not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们从这海飘流到那海， 从北到东， 到处奔走，要寻求耶和华的话， 却寻不见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从这海飘流到那海， 从北到东， 到处奔走，要寻求耶和华的话， 却寻不见。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必飘流，从这海到那海， 从北边到东边，往来奔跑， 寻求耶和华的话，却寻不着。
verses.textEnNiv: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the Lord , but they will not find it.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall wander from sea to sea, and from north to east; they shall run to and fro, to seek the word of the Lord , but they shall not find it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall wander from sea to sea, And from north to east; They shall run to and fro, seeking the word of the Lord, But shall not find it.
verses.textEnNlt: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from border to border searching for the word of the Lord , but they will not find it.
verses.textEnNasb: "People will stagger from sea to sea And from the north even to the east; They will roam about to seek the word of the Lord, But they will not find it.
verses.textEn: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the Lord , but they will not find it.

verses.textZh: "到那日，美丽的少女 和青年男子都因干渴昏倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，美丽的少女 和青年男子都因干渴昏倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，美貌的处女 和少年的男子必因干渴发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day "the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: "In that day the lovely virgins and the young men shall faint for thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In that day the fair virgins And strong young men Shall faint from thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: Beautiful girls and strong young men will grow faint in that day, thirsting for the Lord ’s word.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day the beautiful virgins And the young men will faint from thirst.
verses.textEn: "In that day "the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.

verses.textZh: 那些指着撒玛利亚的罪 起誓， 或是那些指着但的神， 或别是巴的神 起誓的， 他们要倒下，再不能起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些指着撒玛利亚的罪 起誓， 或是那些指着但的神， 或别是巴的神 起誓的， 他们要倒下，再不能起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那指着撒马利亚牛犊 起誓的说： 但哪，我们指着你那里的活神起誓； 又说：我们指着别是巴的神道 起誓。 这些人都必仆倒，永不再起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria— who say, ‘As surely as your god lives, Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the god of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again."
verses.textEnEsv: Those who swear by the Guilt of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god lives, O Dan,’ and, ‘As the Way of Beersheba lives,’ they shall fall, and never rise again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, Who say, ‘As your god lives, O Dan!’ And, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives!’ They shall fall and never rise again."
verses.textEnNlt: And those who swear by the shameful idols of Samaria— who take oaths in the name of the god of Dan and make vows in the name of the god of Beersheba — they will all fall down, never to rise again."
verses.textEnNasb: "As for those who swear by the guilt of Samaria, And say, ‘As your god lives, Dan,’ And, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ They will fall and not rise again."
verses.textEn: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria— who say, ‘As surely as your god lives, Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the god of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again."

verses.textZh: 我见主站在祭坛旁，他说： "击打圣殿的柱顶， 使门槛都震动。 砍掉它们，落在众人的头上， 剩下的人我必用刀杀死； 没有一个能逃走， 没有一人逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我见主站在祭坛旁，他说： "击打圣殿的柱顶， 使门槛都震动。 砍掉它们，落在众人的头上， 剩下的人我必用刀杀死； 没有一个能逃走， 没有一人逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见主站在祭坛旁边； 他说：你要击打柱顶，使门槛震动， 打碎柱顶，落在众人头上； 所剩下的人，我必用刀杀戮， 无一人能逃避，无一人能逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: "Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said: "Strike the capitals until the thresholds shake, and shatter them on the heads of all the people; and those who are left of them I will kill with the sword; not one of them shall flee away; not one of them shall escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and He said: "Strike the doorposts, that the thresholds may shake, And break them on the heads of them all. I will slay the last of them with the sword. He who flees from them shall not get away, And he who escapes from them shall not be delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a vision of the Lord standing beside the altar. He said, "Strike the tops of the Temple columns, so that the foundation will shake. Bring down the roof on the heads of the people below. I will kill with the sword those who survive. No one will escape!
verses.textEnNasb: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said, "Strike the pillar capitals so that the thresholds will shake, And break them on the heads of them all! Then I will put to death the rest of them with the sword; They will not have a fugitive who will flee, Nor a survivor who will escape.
verses.textEn: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: "Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.

verses.textZh: 如果他们下到阴间， 就是在那里，我的手必把他们揪上来； 如果他们升到天上， 就是在那里，我必把他们拉下来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们下到阴间， 就是在那里，我的手必把他们揪上来； 如果他们升到天上， 就是在那里，我必把他们拉下来；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们虽然挖透阴间， 我的手必取出他们来； 虽然爬上天去， 我必拿下他们来；
verses.textEnNiv: Though they dig down to the depths below, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens above, from there I will bring them down.
verses.textEnEsv: "If they dig into Sheol, from there shall my hand take them; if they climb up to heaven, from there I will bring them down.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Though they dig into hell, From there My hand shall take them; Though they climb up to heaven, From there I will bring them down;
verses.textEnNlt: "Even if they dig down to the place of the dead, I will reach down and pull them up. Even if they climb up into the heavens, I will bring them down.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though they dig into Sheol, From there My hand will take them; And though they ascend to heaven, From there I will bring them down.
verses.textEn: Though they dig down to the depths below, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens above, from there I will bring them down.

verses.textZh: 如果他们躲在迦密山顶， 就是在那里，我必搜寻他们，抓他们出来； 如果他们要躲避我，藏在海底， 就是在那里，我必命令蛇去咬他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们躲在迦密山顶， 就是在那里，我必搜寻他们，抓他们出来； 如果他们要躲避我，藏在海底， 就是在那里，我必命令蛇去咬他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然藏在迦密山顶， 我必搜寻，捉出他们来； 虽然从我眼前藏在海底， 我必命蛇咬他们；
verses.textEnNiv: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
verses.textEnEsv: If they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, from there I will search them out and take them; and if they hide from my sight at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it shall bite them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And though they hide themselves on top of Carmel, From there I will search and take them; Though they hide from My sight at the bottom of the sea, From there I will command the serpent, and it shall bite them;
verses.textEnNlt: Even if they hide at the very top of Mount Carmel, I will search them out and capture them. Even if they hide at the bottom of the ocean, I will send the sea serpent after them to bite them.
verses.textEnNasb: "And though they hide on the summit of Carmel, I will track them down and take them from there; And though they hide themselves from My sight on the bottom of the sea, I will command the serpent from there, and it will bite them.
verses.textEn: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.

verses.textZh: 如果他们被仇敌掳去， 就是在那里，我必命令刀剑杀死他们； 我必定睛在他们身上，降祸不降福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们被仇敌掳去， 就是在那里，我必命令刀剑杀死他们； 我必定睛在他们身上，降祸不降福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 虽被仇敌掳去， 我必命刀剑杀戮他们； 我必向他们定住眼目， 降祸不降福。
verses.textEnNiv: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. "I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good."
verses.textEnEsv: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it shall kill them; and I will fix my eyes upon them for evil and not for good."
verses.textEnNkjv: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, From there I will command the sword, And it shall slay them. I will set My eyes on them for harm and not for good."
verses.textEnNlt: Even if their enemies drive them into exile, I will command the sword to kill them there. I am determined to bring disaster upon them and not to help them."
verses.textEnNasb: "And though they go into captivity before their enemies, From there I will command the sword and it will kill them, And I will set My eyes against them for harm and not for good."
verses.textEn: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. "I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good."

verses.textZh: 万军之主耶和华摸地，地就融化， 住在地上的都要悲哀。 这地必像尼罗河高涨， 像埃及的大河退落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之主耶和华摸地，地就融化， 住在地上的都要悲哀。 这地必像尼罗河高涨， 像埃及的大河退落。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华摸地，地就消化， 凡住在地上的都必悲哀。 地必全然像尼罗河涨起， 如同埃及河落下。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord, the Lord Almighty— he touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it mourn; the whole land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God of hosts, he who touches the earth and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn, and all of it rises like the Nile, and sinks again, like the Nile of Egypt;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God of hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, And all who dwell there mourn; All of it shall swell like the River, And subside like the River of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, touches the land and it melts, and all its people mourn. The ground rises like the Nile River at floodtime, and then it sinks again.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God of armies, The One who touches the land so that it quakes, And all those who live in it mourn, And all of it rises up like the Nile And subsides like the Nile of Egypt;
verses.textEn: The Lord, the Lord Almighty— he touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it mourn; the whole land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt;

verses.textZh: 那在天上建立楼阁， 在大地之上奠立穹苍； 又吩咐海水， 把海水倒在地上的； 耶和华就是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那在天上建立楼阁， 在大地之上奠立穹苍； 又吩咐海水， 把海水倒在地上的； 耶和华就是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 那在天上建造楼阁、 在地上安定穹苍、 命海水浇在地上的－ 耶和华是他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: he builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth; he calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: who builds his upper chambers in the heavens and founds his vault upon the earth; who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out upon the surface of the earth— the Lord is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who builds His layers in the sky, And has founded His strata in the earth; Who calls for the waters of the sea, And pours them out on the face of the earth— The Lordis His name.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord ’s home reaches up to the heavens, while its foundation is on the earth. He draws up water from the oceans and pours it down as rain on the land. The Lord is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: The One who builds His upper chambers in the heavens And has founded His vaulted dome over the earth, He who calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the face of the earth, The Lord is His name.
verses.textEn: he builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth; he calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.

verses.textZh: "以色列人哪！ 在我看来，你们不是与古实人一样吗？ 我带领以色列人出埃及地， 不是也领非利士人出迦斐托， 领亚兰人出吉珥吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人哪！ 在我看来，你们不是与古实人一样吗？ 我带领以色列人出埃及地， 不是也领非利士人出迦斐托， 领亚兰人出吉珥吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：以色列人哪， 我岂不看你们如古实人吗？ 我岂不是领以色列人出埃及地， 领非利士人出迦斐托， 领亚兰人出吉珥吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites ?" declares the Lord . "Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?
verses.textEnEsv: "Are you not like the Cushites to me, O people of Israel?" declares the Lord . "Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Are you not like the people of Ethiopia to Me, O children of Israel?" says the Lord. "Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt, The Philistines from Caphtor, And the Syrians from Kir?
verses.textEnNlt: "Are you Israelites more important to me than the Ethiopians? " asks the Lord . "I brought Israel out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and led the Arameans out of Kir.
verses.textEnNasb: "Are you not as the sons of Ethiopia to Me, You sons of Israel?" declares the Lord. "Have I not brought up Israel from the land of Egypt, And the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?
verses.textEn: "Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites ?" declares the Lord . "Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

verses.textZh: "看哪！耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国， 我要把它从地上除灭； 却必不把雅各家完全除灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国， 我要把它从地上除灭； 却必不把雅各家完全除灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国， 必将这国从地上灭绝， 却不将雅各家灭绝净尽。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely the eyes of the Sovereign Lord are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not totally destroy the descendants of Jacob," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the surface of the ground, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the eyes of the Lord Godare on the sinful kingdom, And I will destroy it from the face of the earth; Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Sovereign Lord , am watching this sinful nation of Israel. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. But I will never completely destroy the family of Israel, " says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are on the sinful kingdom, And I will eliminate it from the face of the earth; Nevertheless, I will not totally eliminate the house of Jacob," Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Surely the eyes of the Sovereign Lord are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not totally destroy the descendants of Jacob," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："看哪！我必下令， 我必在列国中筛以色列家， 好象人用筛子筛谷， 但谷粒不会落在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："看哪！我必下令， 我必在列国中筛以色列家， 好象人用筛子筛谷， 但谷粒不会落在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必出令， 将以色列家分散在列国中， 好像用筛子筛谷， 连一粒也不落在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: "For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: "For behold, I will command, and shake the house of Israel among all the nations as one shakes with a sieve, but no pebble shall fall to the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For surely I will command, And will sift the house of Israel among all nations, As grain is sifted in a sieve; Yet not the smallest grain shall fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: "For I will give the command and will shake Israel along with the other nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, yet not one true kernel will be lost.
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I am commanding, And I will shake the house of Israel among all nations As grain is shaken in a sieve, But not a pebble will fall to the ground.
verses.textEn: "For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.

verses.textZh: 我民中所有犯罪的人， 就是那些说：‘灾祸必不临近、追上我们’的人， 他们必死在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我民中所有犯罪的人， 就是那些说：‘灾祸必不临近、追上我们’的人， 他们必死在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我民中的一切罪人说： 灾祸必追不上我们， 也迎不着我们。 他们必死在刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’
verses.textEnEsv: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, ‘Disaster shall not overtake or meet us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: All the sinners of My people shall die by the sword, Who say, ‘The calamity shall not overtake nor confront us.’
verses.textEnNlt: But all the sinners will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Nothing bad will happen to us.’
verses.textEnNasb: "All the sinners of My people will die by the sword, Those who say, ‘The catastrophe will not overtake or confront us.’
verses.textEn: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’

verses.textZh: "到那日，我必竖立大卫倒塌的帐棚， 修补它们的破口； 我必重建它的废墟， 使它像往日一样建立起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，我必竖立大卫倒塌的帐棚， 修补它们的破口； 我必重建它的废墟， 使它像往日一样建立起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，我必建立大卫倒塌的帐幕， 堵住其中的破口， 把那破坏的建立起来， 重新修造，像古时一样，
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day "I will restore David’s fallen shelter— I will repair its broken walls and restore its ruins— and will rebuild it as it used to be,
verses.textEnEsv: "In that day I will raise up the booth of David that is fallen and repair its breaches, and raise up its ruins and rebuild it as in the days of old,
verses.textEnNkjv: "On that day I will raise up The tabernacle of David, which has fallen down, And repair its damages; I will raise up its ruins, And rebuild it as in the days of old;
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day I will restore the fallen house of David. I will repair its damaged walls. From the ruins I will rebuild it and restore its former glory.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day I will raise up the fallen shelter of David, And wall up its gaps; I will also raise up its ruins And rebuild it as in the days of old;
verses.textEn: "In that day "I will restore David’s fallen shelter— I will repair its broken walls and restore its ruins— and will rebuild it as it used to be,

verses.textZh: 好使他们获得以东所余剩的， 以及所有称为我名下的国。" 这是行这些事的耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使他们获得以东所余剩的， 以及所有称为我名下的国。" 这是行这些事的耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 使以色列人得以东所余剩的 和所有称为我名下的国。 此乃行这事的耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name, " declares the Lord , who will do these things.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name," declares the Lord who does this.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, And all the Gentiles who are called by My name," Says the Lord who does this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: And Israel will possess what is left of Edom and all the nations I have called to be mine. " The Lord has spoken, and he will do these things.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they may possess the remnant of Edom And all the nations who are called by My name," Declares the Lord who does this.
verses.textEn: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name, " declares the Lord , who will do these things.

verses.textZh: "日子快到，这是耶和华的宣告。 耕地的必紧接着收割的， 踹葡萄的必紧接着撒种的； 大山必滴下甜酒， 小山必融化。
verses.textZhCnvs: "日子快到，这是耶和华的宣告。 耕地的必紧接着收割的， 踹葡萄的必紧接着撒种的； 大山必滴下甜酒， 小山必融化。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 日子将到， 耕种的必接续收割的； 踹葡萄的必接续撒种的； 大山要滴下甜酒； 小山都必流奶 。
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills,
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when the plowman shall overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes him who sows the seed; the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and all the hills shall flow with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "When the plowman shall overtake the reaper, And the treader of grapes him who sows seed; The mountains shall drip with sweet wine, And all the hills shall flow withit.
verses.textEnNlt: "The time will come," says the Lord , "when the grain and grapes will grow faster than they can be harvested. Then the terraced vineyards on the hills of Israel will drip with sweet wine!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "When the plowman will overtake the reaper, And the one who treads grapes will overtake him who sows the seed; When the mountains will drip grape juice, And all the hills will come apart.
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills,

verses.textZh: 我必使我的子民以色列被掳的人回归， 他们必重建荒废的城，住在其中； 他们必栽种葡萄园，喝园中的酒； 建造果园，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使我的子民以色列被掳的人回归， 他们必重建荒废的城，住在其中； 他们必栽种葡萄园，喝园中的酒； 建造果园，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使我民以色列被掳的归回； 他们必重修荒废的城邑居住， 栽种葡萄园，喝其中所出的酒， 修造果木园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: and I will bring my people Israel back from exile. "They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel, and they shall rebuild the ruined cities and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and drink their wine, and they shall make gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring back the captives of My people Israel; They shall build the waste cities and inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards and drink wine from them; They shall also make gardens and eat fruit from them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring my exiled people of Israel back from distant lands, and they will rebuild their ruined cities and live in them again. They will plant vineyards and gardens; they will eat their crops and drink their wine.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also restore the fortunes of My people Israel, And they will rebuild the desolated cities and live in them; They will also plant vineyards and drink their wine, And make gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.textEn: and I will bring my people Israel back from exile. "They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

verses.textZh: 我必把他们栽于他们自己的土地， 他们再不会从我赐给他们的土地上被拔除。" 这是耶和华你的神说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把他们栽于他们自己的土地， 他们再不会从我赐给他们的土地上被拔除。" 这是耶和华你的神说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将他们栽于本地， 他们不再从我所赐给他们的地上拔出来。 这是耶和华－你的神说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them," says the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: I will plant them on their land, and they shall never again be uprooted out of the land that I have given them," says the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will plant them in their land, And no longer shall they be pulled up From the land I have given them," Says the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will firmly plant them there in their own land. They will never again be uprooted from the land I have given them," says the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also plant them on their land, And they will not be uprooted again from their land Which I have given them," Says the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them," says the Lord your God.
